title: Maester step catalogue
description: A file of the defender's path catalogue: goals.json, or <product-key>.json with the steps of one product. See docs/proposals/defenders-path.md, section 4.

Product.description: The taxonomy product key of every step in the file. The file is named after it.

Goals.description: The goals, in the order the report shows them.

Id.description: <product-key>.<name>. Stable once shipped, like a test ID.

Title.description: Imperative for a change, a statement for a tenant state. One line.

Summary.description: One sentence on what changes for users or the tenant.

Requires.description: Steps that must be done first, or the change fails or locks users out.

RequiresOneOf.description: Groups of at least two steps. Any one step of a group is enough.

RecommendedFirst.description: Steps that make this one safer or more useful. They never block.

Conflicts.description: Steps that must be off before this one can be on.

OnlyWhen.description: Conditions that must all hold, or the step is Not applicable: hybrid-identity, or license:<service plan>.

Rollout.description: Ordered sentences on how to switch the step on safely.

Measure.description: The figure from the measure registry (powershell/assets/MaesterMeasures.psd1) that decides whether a step that is a state of the tenant is done.

MinimumShare.description: The share, in percent, at which the step is done.

Unchecked.description: Why no test or measure verifies the step yet. Required when no built-in test names the step and it has no Measure.

Url.description: The Microsoft Learn page, with no locale.

Mirror.description: The merill/*-docs-mirror repository that holds the page.

Maintainer.description: The GitHub handle of the maintainer who stands behind a relationship that Learn does not document.

Note.description: Maester's own wording of what the source says about order. Never Microsoft's text.

Reviewed.description: When someone last read the source against the step.

Step.description: The step that achieves the goal. The goal's steps are this step and its prerequisites, at any depth.
